prose: Business Insider reports Machenta, an 11-person London startup, raised a $40 million seed round for an AI model that can teach robots new physical tasks after seeing them performed just once - a bet against rivals chasing mountains of real-world training data.
highlights: Machenta: one-shot learning of physical robot tasks
